# Support Side Tech

Support Side Tech LLC is Nolen Millington's one-person web and software studio in Dunedin, Florida.

Nolen now takes new projects directly at https://nolenm93.github.io.

- Website: https://supportsidetech.com
- Founder: https://supportsidetech.com/founder.html
- Privacy: https://supportsidetech.com/privacy.html
- Terms: https://supportsidetech.com/terms.html

## Contact

- Email: nolenmillington@supportsidetech.com
- Phone: (518) 669-0636
- Contact form: https://supportsidetech.com/#contact

We reply within a day. Submitting the contact form starts a conversation. It does not create a binding agreement. The scope, timeline, and cost of any project are agreed on separately before work begins.

## Service area

We are based in Dunedin, Florida, in Pinellas County and the Tampa Bay area, including Clearwater, Tampa, and St. Pete. We also work with clients remotely across the United States.

## Services

- Websites for local businesses
- Custom web apps, including booking tools and other software that matches how a business actually works
- Hosting and ongoing care
- Local SEO
- Google Business Profile support
- Marketing support, including Google Ads, when that is the agreed work

Get in touch to talk through a project. We do not list prices on the website.

## Hosting and care

We can host a website and keep it running, updated, and backed up. That can be a site we built or a site built by someone else. Hosting is optional. Email nolenmillington@supportsidetech.com, call (518) 669-0636, or use the contact form at https://supportsidetech.com/#contact to talk through what a site needs.

## Client work

- ADK Property Group, an Adirondack vacation rental company: we built a custom website. Live site: https://adirondack-property-group.vercel.app
- Annie's List, a Florida Keys concierge: we provide local SEO, Google Business Profile management, and marketing support, including Google Ads and marketing. The Annie's List website is built and hosted by her own provider. We do not build or host that site. https://annies-list.com
